# 1 Hippogriff

*Large monstrosity, unaligned*

## Actions

***Multiattack.*** It pecks and screeches in one go.

***Peck.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

***Screech.*** A shrill cry that forces a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw.
